title: Ultimate Cruise & Vacation

services.name: Small Ship Cruises
services.desc: We love the sailing experience, seeing the sails and especially the raising of the sails after stops with the famous Vangelis song in the air. But this itinerary is made for sailing vessels like Star Flyer. We will set sail from St Maarten on Saturday, January 9, 2027 for 7-glorious nights. Stopping first in Anguilla, before sailing foer Jost Van Dyke B.V.I., Soper's Hole - Tortola B.V.I., Sail Sir Francis Drake Channel, also visit The Bight - Norman Island B.V.I., Virgin Gorda B.V.I., the Captain's Beach Stop B.V.I., St Kitts, Friars Beach Bay Beach & St Barts. Count them 10 stops in all. Several days we will stop at a location in the morning, reboard for lunch while the ship repositions

blurb: Ultimate Vacations specializes in all-inclusive vacations, honeymoons, anniversaries, destination weddings, and specialty cruises. They offer personalized expert service and plan customized vacations to various destinations including Mexico, the Caribbean, Hawaii, South Pacific, Europe, and Disney. Their main office serves the greater Kansas City area with additional staff in St Louis, MO, Omaha, NE, and Alabama.
